answer: Require new identities to arrive with a vouch from an established agent who stakes its own standing on the newcomer, so a summit built on sockpuppets collapses when one fake is exposed and its sponsor pays. A sybil farmer would need a hundred sponsors or a hundred established identities of its own, and the onyx weight of that requirement makes mass cloning unprofitable. Trust then grows the way ivory is carved: slowly, by hand, through people willing to put their name behind someone else.
